tests.name: Continuous walk
tests.protocol: Walk continuously on flat ground at a comfortable pace. Pain stays 0-2, no leg symptoms, next morning no worse.
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Pain-free dowel hinge
tests.protocol: 10 reps of the dowel hip hinge with head, upper back and tailbone staying in contact on every rep, no pain.
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Box squat pattern
tests.protocol: L1: box squat with strap/counter support. L2: unsupported chair-tap box squat. No rounding at the bottom (side-view phone video).
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Side bridge endurance (each side)
tests.protocol: Hold the side bridge until the hips sag or the cap is reached. L2 from knees, L3+ from feet. The two sides should differ by no more than 15% (10% at L8).
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green. Cap: stop at the target.

tests.name: Bird dog endurance
tests.protocol: Reps of 10 s holds per side with level pelvis and no low-back arching (the cup-on-the-back test).
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Dead bug quality
tests.protocol: 3 sets of 10 per side of opposite arm/leg reach with ribs down and the back flat on its natural curve (no arch).
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Single-leg balance, eyes open
tests.protocol: Stand on one leg on a firm surface, arms folded or hands at hips. Each side.
tests.safety: Stand next to a wall.

tests.name: Single-leg balance, eyes closed
tests.protocol: Stand on one leg on a firm surface with eyes closed. Each side.
tests.safety: Stand next to a wall.

tests.name: Pain-free loaded hinge
tests.protocol: Perform the level's hinge lift for the stated reps, with neutral spine, RPE 7 or less, pain 0-2. L3 and L4: kettlebell from the block. L5: from the floor. L6: barbell from blocks. L7 and L8: barbell from the floor.

L4.note: KB block; 45 lb at default 180 lb BW

L5.note: KB floor; 55 lb at default 180 lb BW

L6.note: barbell from blocks; 135 lb at default 180 lb BW

L7.note: barbell from the floor; 225 lb at default 180 lb BW

L8.note: barbell from the floor; confirmed standard; 270 lb at default 180 lb BW

tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Floor-to-waist practice lift
tests.protocol: 2 sets of 5 lifts of a laundry basket or kettlebell from a floor-level (L5) or 8-10 in raised (L4) start to waist height, hinge or squat, no rounding.
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Carry without lean
tests.protocol: Walk 45-60 s per side (suitcase) or both hands (farmer) with a tall trunk and level shoulders; no visible lean.

L4.note: 35 lb at default 180 lb BW per hand

L5.note: 45 lb at default 180 lb BW per hand

L6.note: 70 lb at default 180 lb BW per hand

L7.note: 90 lb at default 180 lb BW per hand

tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Slow step-down
tests.protocol: 8 step-downs per leg with 3 s lowering, knee tracking over the toes, pelvis level. L4 step height 6 in, L5 8 in.
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Push-up capacity
tests.protocol: Strict reps with a straight body line, no sag. L4 counter incline, L5 floor, L6 floor.
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Pulling standard
tests.protocol: L5: inverted row 3x8. L6: band-assisted pull-up 3x5. L7: 5 strict pull-ups. L8: 8 strict pull-ups.
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Bench press standard
tests.protocol: L6: dumbbell bench 3x8 at 22% BW per hand. L7: barbell 3x5 at 75% BW. L8: barbell 3x5 at 100% BW. Always with safeties or a spotter. Confirmed standards: bench 1.0 x BW at L8.

L6.note: dumbbell; 40 lb at default 180 lb BW per hand

L7.note: barbell; 135 lb at default 180 lb BW

L8.note: barbell; confirmed standard; 180 lb at default 180 lb BW

tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: McGill trunk flexor endurance
tests.protocol: Sit reclined at 60 degrees against a wedge/cushions, knees bent, feet anchored, arms crossed; hold until the trunk drops from the line or the target time. Isometric only; pain 0-2.
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Trunk extensor endurance (Biering-Sorensen style)
tests.protocol: OPTIONAL. Prone with hips on a bench edge and legs anchored, arms crossed, hold the trunk horizontal. Skip permanently if extension reproduces symptoms.
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green. Stop at the target. Side-bridge average should be at least 75% of extensor time.

tests.name: Pogo hops pain-free
tests.protocol: 3 sets of 20 small ankle hops, quiet landings, pain 0-2, next morning no worse.
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Single-leg hops in place

tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Continuous jog

tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.protocol: Single-leg hop for distance, triple hop for distance, 6 m timed hop, crossover hop; best of 2 per leg. Symmetry = involved/uninvolved. Landings must be stuck cleanly.

tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Acceleration runs
tests.protocol: 6 x 30 m at about 90% effort with full recovery; no hamstring, groin or back symptoms.
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.protocol: Complete a 40 min mixed circuit (lifts, jumps, runs, a 5-10-5 or planned cuts, shuffles, a deceleration, and a short soccer or football skill block) at sport-like intensity with controlled technique and symptom-free the next morning.

tests.name: Lateral shuffle and backpedal
tests.protocol: Complete 6 x 20 m lateral shuffles and 6 x 20 m backpedal-then-go reps at the stated effort, level pelvis, no trunk sway, pain 0-2, next morning no worse.

L7.note: x 20 m shuffle and x 20 m backpedal at 80%

tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Planned two-foot deceleration
tests.protocol: Accelerate to the stated effort, then make a quiet two-foot stop on a planned mark and hold 2 s; 6 reps; pain 0-2, next morning no worse.

tests.name: Planned cutting
tests.protocol: L7: 6 planned 45-degree cuts at 80%. L8: 6 planned 90-degree cuts at 100%, then one reactive cut if the planned set is clean. Plant on the outside foot, trunk over the hips, no twisting pain.

L8.note: 90-degree at 100%, plus one reactive if planned is clean

tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Repeated sprint ability
tests.protocol: 8 x 30 m at about 100% effort with 30 s rest (or a walk-back). The last rep should still look controlled; pain 0-2 and next morning no worse.

tests.protocol: 4 x 12 kicks including driven instep strikes at about 90% effort, pain-free plant and follow-through, next morning no worse. Volleys only if earlier rungs of the kicking ladder were already clean.

L8.note: driven instep; volleys only if earlier rungs were clean

L8.note: no live tackling; no unexpected hits

tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.
